metadata.evidence: This paper explores the task of interactive image retrieval using natural language queries, where a user progressively provides input queries to refine a set of retrieval results.
metadata.reason: Defines the research task addressed by the artifact.

metadata.evidence: We propose Drill-down, an effective framework for encoding multiple queries with an efficient compact state representation that significantly extends current methods for single-round image retrieval.
metadata.reason: Name of the proposed framework implemented by this repository.

metadata.value: automatic image retrieval on a simulated scenario that uses region captions as queries, and interactive image retrieval using real queries from human evaluators
metadata.normalized_value: automatic image retrieval on a simulated scenario that uses region captions as queries, and interactive image retrieval using real queries from human evaluators
metadata.evidence: demonstrating superior performance on two proposed benchmarks: automatic image retrieval on a simulated scenario that uses region captions as queries, and interactive image retrieval using real queries from human evaluators.
metadata.reason: Names the two evaluation benchmarks proposed and used in the paper.
